label: Music Assistant MCP
info: Music Assistant MCP-tools. Anslutning sker via WebSocket-RPC mot MUSIC_ASSISTANT_URL/ws. Kräver att 'ws'-modulen är tillåten i Node-RED settings.js (functionExternalModules: true).

name: Get outputs
description: List the speakers registered in Music Assistant together with their current grouping: "leads" holds the speakers synced to this one, "synced_to" names the speaker it follows (null when it is free). Use it to discover names before music_set_outputs and to inspect the grouping that is actually in place.

name: players/all
Set outputs
description: Select which rooms/speakers should receive audio. The first speaker in the list becomes the sync leader and the rest are joined to it. This sets the output set rather than adding to it: every listed speaker is first released from any group it already belongs to. Workflow: 1) music_set_outputs to pick rooms, 2) music_play to start music. The grouping is read back from Music Assistant before this answers — "verified": true means the group really exists, and "not_grouped" lists any speaker MA declined to join. Allow a few seconds when speakers have to be regrouped. On failure the payload carries an "error" field.
inputSchema: {"type":"object","required":["names"],"properties":{"names":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Speaker names (case-insensitive) — use music_get_outputs for available names. First entry becomes the leader."},"volume":{"type":"integer","description":"Volume 0-100 to set on grouped outputs (optional)","minimum":0,"maximum":100}}}

name: players/cmd/set_members
Play media
description: Play media on the currently selected outputs — call music_set_outputs first. Accepts a Spotify/Apple Music URI, or free text, in which case the closest title match wins, preferring the local library, then Spotify, then Apple Music. The queue is read back before this answers: "verified": true means it reached playing state, and "now_playing" is what the queue actually holds, which can differ from what was requested. Allow several seconds. On failure the payload carries an "error" field.
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"uri":{"type":"string","description":"Spotify URI — e.g. spotify:playlist:37i9dQZF1DX... or spotify:track:4iV5W9uY..."},"query":{"type":"string","description":"Free-text search; the first matching track is played (used when uri is not provided)"},"shuffle":{"type":"boolean","description":"Enable shuffle mode before playing"}}}

name: player_queues/play_media
Player control
description: Control Music Assistant playback and read player status. Use action="status" (or omit it) to get live state taken from the active queue: the player, the queue that owns the audio (which may be a different player — see "queue_on_another_player" and "synced_to"), what is playing, volume, shuffle, repeat and Don't Stop The Music. This is the single source of truth for whether music is playing right now. Any agent asked "is music playing?" — regardless of what it did earlier in the conversation, and regardless of how much time has passed — MUST call this with action="status" before answering, never inferring playback from an earlier call. Actions: play, pause, stop, next, previous, status. A group volume 0-100 can be set alongside any action.
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["play","pause","stop","next","previous","status"],"description":"Playback action — omit or use status to get player state"},"volume":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":100,"description":"Group volume 0-100 (can be combined with action)"}}}

name: player_queues (status + transport)
Set volume per speaker
description: Set the volume for one or more speakers individually, without changing which speakers are active. Use names from music_get_outputs. The reply lists what was applied under "updated"; anything under "not_found" or "failed" was not set.

name: players/cmd/volume_set
Search library
description: Search the Music Assistant library and connected providers (Spotify, Apple Music) for tracks, albums, artists or playlists. Results are ordered by how closely the name matches the query, with the local library preferred over Spotify over Apple Music between equally good matches. Returns URIs to hand to music_play.
inputSchema: {"type":"object","required":["query"],"properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Search terms"},"type":{"type":"string","description":"Comma-separated media types: track, album, artist, playlist (default: track,album,artist,playlist)"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":25,"description":"Max results per type (default 5)"}}}

name: music/search
Don't Stop The Music
description: Toggle endless radio continuation (Don't Stop The Music — MA's autoplay setting) on the active queue. When enabled, Music Assistant extends the queue with similar tracks as it runs out. The setting is read back from the queue and returned as "dont_stop_the_music". It only takes audible effect once the queue reaches its end, and it does not start playback on its own; music_player(status) reports the current setting as well.

name: player_queues/autoplay
Repeat mode
description: Set the repeat mode on the active queue: off = no repeat, one = loop the current track, all = loop the whole queue. The mode is read back from the queue and returned as "repeat". Repeat does not apply to a dynamic queue (radio or Don't Stop The Music); on one of those this returns verified:false and says so, rather than changing anything.

name: player_queues/repeat
Favorite track
description: Mark a track as favorited/liked in Music Assistant, defaulting to whatever is playing on the active queue when no uri is given. The favorite propagates to the underlying provider (e.g. Spotify "Liked Songs") when that provider allows library edits. Removing a favorite only works for a track that is in the library.
inputSchema: {"type": "object", "required": ["action"], "properties": {"action": {"type": "string", "enum": ["add", "remove"], "description": "Whether to add (like) or remove (unlike) the favorite"}, "uri": {"type": "string", "description": "Optional media URI. Defaults to the currently playing track on the active leader."}}}

name: music/favorites/{add,remove}_item
